chunks: Do they not think they will be raised (to life) again
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the disbelief in resurrection?
ai.summary: In the Surah Al-Mutaffifin, this rhetorical question targets the arrogant disbelievers who denied the Day of Resurrection, a core tenet emphasized in Shia theology as the foundation of divine justice (Adl). The verse underscores the inevitability of accountability, reminding the faithful that their denial of the Hereafter was a willful ignorance of God's power to recreate them.
